description: Update stock quantity for a product (Holded API v2). BREAKING CHANGE from v1: `warehouse_id` is now required; `stock_variation` replaces `units`; optional `variant_id` and `description` added.

description.description: Audit note describing the stock adjustment (optional)

stock_variation.description: Stock delta (positive to add, negative to subtract). Replaces v1 `units`.

variant_id.description: Variant ID to target a specific product variant (optional)

warehouse_id.description: Warehouse ID (required in v2 — v2 rejects stock updates without it)

name: update_product_stock
